scope: Two principal acquisition campaigns and three separate reference/control cohorts. Not a complete count of all historical energy experiments.
counting_unit: One physical benchmark execution with a valid final-window outcome. Multiple sensors and numerical reanalyses are not added.

sources.counting_unit: One physical benchmark execution with a valid final-window outcome.

selection_rules.rate_grid: Series/window from direct_rates.csv, checked against paper_window_policy.csv; pico rows from groups_all_candidates.csv; n counts valid executions.
selection_rules.duration_grid: n from duration.csv, independently checked against unique (platform, slug, series, window, requested_s, record_id) in paired_all_durations.csv.
selection_rules.reference: Sum of common_rate_valid_pairs for include_in_paper and common_reference_ready rows in workload_inventory.csv; each instrument pair counts once.

sources.overlap_policy: The 15 long-interval FP16 traces, 30 Hailo spectral traces, and 225 fixed-window reanalyses are subsets of the rate campaign and are not counted again. No overall total across campaigns is claimed.
sources.processing: Inventory filtering, execution-ID deduplication, integer count aggregation, and consistency checks only.

display_label_sources.Jetson/llm: Gemma3-12B is identified in the dissertation excerpt supplied by the user. Repository CSVs label this series llm.
